id: \bTrip: Who would have thought you would be my first challenge. Let's get started.
en: \bTrip: Who would have thought you would be my first challenge. Let's get started.
it: \bTrip: Chi l'avrebbe mai detto che saresti stato la mia prima sfida. Cominciamo.

id: \bTrip: I'm impressed. It's a shame I lost already.
en: \bTrip: I'm impressed. It's a shame I lost already.
it: \bTrip: Sono colpito. Peccato che io abbia già perso.

id: \bCongratulations on winning your first match.\nYour next battle will be on to the right.
en: \bCongratulations on winning your first match.\nYour next battle will be on to the right.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto il tuo primo incontro.\nLa tua prossima lotta si terrà sulla destra.
